subject: CM-S4-PRIVACY/NO-PERSIST
proof: Poisoned readFile/writeFile/keychain ports during temporary remove/state/retry/end/new-epoch replay: zero calls.
Entire isolated temporary state and source-root trees remain byte-for-byte unchanged; no removal checkpoints/artifacts/prompts are created by this path.
SDK-close and credential-journal failure payloads include synthetic endpoint/options/source/credential/ref/session canaries. None appears in removal replies or captured real rotating logs.
A positive normal-daemon log marker proves the actual sink was captured; logging was not globally disabled.
Removal state/error text matches fixed safe copy and stays bounded.
Session end revokes status; fresh owner/epoch rejects the old ticket without reconstruction.
compatibilityBoundary: Existing protected sc2 Saved receipts intentionally retain only owned cleanupRefs and signed operation tickets, with their unchanged exact schema. Those refs are necessary for credential cleanup/recovery and are not sc6 wire/log output. No raw config/endpoint/credential/source/session capability is added to receipts; this Story does not change protected storage contracts.
limits: Privacy proof is scoped to removal/state/retry and existing logging/probe regressions, not all provider/model paths.
Temporary config creation may use existing Saved-ID collision metadata before the poisoned removal section; discard/state/retry themselves do not read the registry.
